recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The structural FHIR-36665 change is present, and the remaining necessary work was to remove misleading active NutritionOrder narrative references found in the same schedule area.
issue_request: FHIR-36665 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked how to represent a NutritionOrder PRN/as-needed order and its reason, with the approved change making the oralDiet, supplement, and enteralFormula schedule locations into backbones containing timing, asNeeded, and asNeededFor.
initial_application: No relevant source commit message explicitly named FHIR-36665. Commit 1a5062f0a4, 'Update Nutrition Order with JIRA dispositions,' appears to have applied the decision by adding the schedule backbones and timing/asNeeded/asNeededFor children to oralDiet.schedule, supplement.schedule, and enteralFormula.administration.schedule.
additional_context: NutritionOrder is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition contains all requested PRN schedule children. Confluence OO minutes list FHIR-36665 in the R5 NutritionOrder ballot/application trail. The surrounding active NutritionOrder notes page still referenced removed enteral formula paths, including enteralFormula.schedule, which conflicted with the current StructureDefinition.
reconciliation: Updated source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-notes.xml to use enteralFormula.maxVolumeToAdminister and enteralFormula.administration.schedule, keeping the narrative aligned with the authoritative current element paths and the applied schedule backbone.
source_changes: source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-notes.xml: corrected the enteral feeding note to reference enteralFormula.maxVolumeToAdminister and enteralFormula.administration.schedule instead of removed paths.
